negative_reviews.author: Ali
negative_reviews.text:
Our main was really good and tasty, the desert was probably up there with the worst I've paid for at a restaurant.

The chocolate matcha brownie was a stale hard lump of cardboard. On par with a savers brownie from londis. There was also less than advertised on the menus picture. The Banana fritter was just a greasy deep fried mess, dripping in grease that hadn't been drained off.

Unfortunately the deserts seriously dampened our initial thoughts of or meal, the main was a 4/5 initially.

negative_reviews.author: Hemaxi
negative_reviews.text:
Never going back. First and last visit.

We arrived slightly earlier for our table for 2 booked for 7pm and were seated, no problem. We were waiting around 15 minutes for our drinks order to be taken, and we chose to order food at the same time.

Drinks came over with a very confused server. To us, it was clear the drinks were for us and the table next to us judging by the number of glasses and people. She had to go away and check and then come back to finally give us the drinks.

After that, my food arrived first and we had to wait another 10 minutes or so before my friend's food arrived. My food was getting cold by then. But they served the meat option when the vegan option had been ordered. They took it away and came back another 15 minutes or so later with the correct meal. They didn't even apologise.

The bill came with service charge included and in my opinion, they should have taken the initiative to take money off considering they served meat to someone who doesn't even eat meat. I requested they reconsider, and they returned with another bill with a drink and service charge removed. Ridiculous that we had to ask for that in the first place considering the poor service, but grateful they did do something about the bill. It was at this point we finally had an apology.

negative_reviews.author: Nie72
negative_reviews.text:
Was really looking forward to this and everyone has been hyping M&R up!!  But it was just an aweful experience :( I ended up getting food poisoning from here!! Attended with a friend and we both ordered different things.

I thought I’d be safe with the ramen option and my friend ordered a rack of sushi. The food came pretty quickly despite the slow service .
The sushi was cut so thick and messy with what looked like the ending or trimming of left over fish on the top like they ran out of ingredients ? The ramen I ordered came luke warm, noodles were undercooked but stuck together and only had two king prawns and two thin slices of salmon inside.

The service was also so so slow. There was only 1 person who seemed to be taking everyone’s orders bless her and she looked understandably stressed. The lady rolling the sushi’s looked like she couldn’t really be bothered and it showed from how the rolls came out :(

The only good thing was the Japanese fizzy drink the waitress recommended and catching up with my friend but now regretting it all as I vomit

Sadly won’t be returning again.

negative_reviews.author: Sabrina Taher
negative_reviews.text: Food was mid and the service we got was just diabolical. Walked in and confirmed with the waiter about our booking which was through First Table, he walks us to our table and then just ignores us for about half an hour. We finally order, finish our food and spend another half an hour trying to flag down our original waiter while he asks other tables how their food was. Gave up and asked another member of staff who kindly helped us with the bill. Bill turns out wrong and they have to refund and charge us again because our original waiter hadn’t flagged our table correctly. Finally get things sorted and as we’re about to leave, the original waiter comes over and demands to see our original booking and doesn’t believe that we had a reservation! This was embarrassing and rude and all I can say is I wish I’d taken the service charge off! Don’t go here unless you want to spend 50% of your time being ignored

negative_reviews.author: Mihail Emanuel Ghinea
negative_reviews.text:
I have been to half a dozen different maki and ramen locations and this was definitely the worst one.

The sushi was weirdly dry and the ramen was not very appetizing.

It was also really difficult to grab the staff's attention for ordering and paying the bill.

To top it all off, halfway through we got hit with a horrendous vinegar and dirty socks smell coming (I assume) from the back of the kitchen. Really, really bad.

negative_reviews.author: Zhen Liu
negative_reviews.text: Rather disappointing experience. We were seated in the middle of everyone and asked if we could move to a booth and this was granted by the waiter. Then what appeared to be the maitre d' came over and told us that we cannot sit there because it was for 4 people and was shoved into a corner of the restaurant. Not a great start, staff should be clear on that. Anyway ordered the salmon sushi platter with sashimi, nigiri and uramaki rolls. The sashimi was far from fresh. You can see in the pictures where the flesh is tearing and just falling apart from being picked up. Not good enough at all. The avocado was rock hard and clearly not ripe in the uramaki. Also no bowl for the soy sauce (edit: I had to use the bowl that the extra egg was served in) . You're expected to drown your sushi in the plate it's served on. We ordered the clam sashimi too but the nigiri version arrived instead. We were told we could have the nigiri on the house which is a nice touch but it's only two measley pieces anyway. The one good thing was the ramen itself. Ordered the original tonkotsu and the black garlic version. Both were really good, broth was excellent as were the egg and pork. Just a little bit silly to serve in such an enormous bowl, it looked ridiculous and unnecessary especially when the tables were so incredibly small. It's no better than the other big chains like ippudo so I wouldn't go out of my way for the ramen. If you're lucky you might also get the maitre d' teaching you to pour your broth over your ramen pork to infuse the flavour as if you were a child. Just what customers want. Lastly the food just comes out whenever it's ready which is fine but I'd expect both ramens to come out at the same time...it's not like adding some garlic sauce makes it delayed 5 minutes thereby forcing one person to wait to eat and leaving their food to go cold. Complete amateurs and it's incredible this place has 4.9 stars. It goes to show how little standards we hold for eating out these days.
